Electricity prices, June 2018: The chart shows the price of electricity for households in about 100 countries. The prices are per kWh and include all items in the electricity bill such as the distribution and energy cost, various environmental and fuel cost charges and taxes. These are national averages calculated using the average household consumption of electricity in each country. The methodology of price collection is described on the about page.

Please, contact us if you need the latest prices from March 2019 or historical data. Besides the national average, we can also provide data for several different levels of electricity consumption which is important as prices per kWh vary with consumption. These data are available on the national level and for the largest cities. We can also provide the electricity rates for businesses and other non-residential uses. .
